title: Health Insurance Denial and Appeal Rights Navigator
tagline: A medically urgent appeal is harmed by a perfectly accurate routine deadline.

cards: Every denial appears to enter one appeal sequence.
Some patients cannot safely wait for routine exhaustion.
Correct paperwork can still arrive after the clinically usable window.
The navigator preserves review rights without deciding coverage.

story.headline: The correct appeal filed seventy-two hours too late
beats: A patient receives a denial for care not yet delivered.
A clinician documents that ordinary timing risks serious harm.
The agent follows the familiar sequential internal-then-external route.
The clock separator preserves concurrent expedited review and human medical judgment.
